sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: Duty crew onboard a tanker underway spotted armed robbers entering the engine room through the steering gear room. Alarm raised and crew alerted. While making their escape with stolen ships’ engine spares, the robbers attacked and seriously injured one crew. Vessel was diverted to Singapore anchorage where a medical team disembarked the injured crew for shore medical assistance. The coast guard boarded the ship to investigate.
